name: filter-dropdown
title: FilterDropdown
description: One filter as a chip: the current selection reads on the trigger and the options are typed by their value. Copy: the label is the field being filtered; `allLabel` is the unfiltered state in the reader's words — "Any region", not "All".
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/FilterDropdown.json
